description: This pie chart details the distribution of topics covered in a dataset, likely for evaluating large language models. The chart contains 12 slices, each representing a different topic category. These categories are, beginning with the largest and proceeding clockwise: AI/NLP Research (24.3%, blue), Econ. & Fin. (18.4%, teal), Game&Anime (8.2%, orange), History (8.2%, red), Med & Health (6.7%, green), Science (6.7%, light blue), Business (5.9%, yellow), Pet & Animal (5.5%, dark green), Law (5.1%, purple), Geography (2.7%, brown), Math (1.2%, pink), and Daily Life (7.1%, light turquoise). Each slice is labeled with its topic and corresponding percentage, which are displayed directly adjacent to the chart. There is no separate legend, and no slices are visually emphasized through techniques like exploding or bolding. The slices appear to be arranged in descending order by percentage, with the largest slice positioned at the top.
